name: bank-activation-tight
description: Tightens the two bank-activation limits (FAW, RRD) that gate random-access throughput. These are known-good aggressive values for GDDR5X Pascal.
applies_to: GDDR5X Pascal (GTX 1080, 1080 Ti, Titan X Pascal, Titan Xp). Harmless to try elsewhere; usually a no-op on GDDR5.
